verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents per-identity flag overrides for individual users, explicitly for internal testing, QA and customer support. Segments are documented for releasing features to beta testers. Explicit exclusion of specific users, and list-based allowlists or denylists, are not documented, so coverage of the full story is partial. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding individual users or using allowlist/denylist targeting, step-by-step docs on managing identity overrides, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: Override feature flags for individual users ("identities"). Enables internal testing, QA, customer support, or personalised experiences at the user level.
Segments: Release features to beta testers, collect feedback, and iterate
use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments.
